mapper.select: SELECT i.id,i.material_id,m.material_code,m.material_name,m.specification,i.source_location_id,sz.zone_name source_zone_name,sl.location_code source_location_code,sl.location_name source_location_name,i.target_location_id,tz.zone_name target_zone_name,tl.location_code target_location_code,tl.location_name target_location_name,i.unit_id,u.unit_name,u.precision_scale,i.quantity,i.remark,v.quantity inventory_quantity,v.locked_quantity,(v.quantity-v.locked_quantity) available_quantity FROM wm_transfer_order_item i LEFT JOIN wm_material m ON m.id=i.material_id LEFT JOIN wm_warehouse_location sl ON sl.id=i.source_location_id LEFT JOIN wm_warehouse_zone sz ON sz.id=sl.zone_id LEFT JOIN wm_warehouse_location tl ON tl.id=i.target_location_id LEFT JOIN wm_warehouse_zone tz ON tz.id=tl.zone_id LEFT JOIN wm_unit u ON u.id=i.unit_id LEFT JOIN wm_transfer_order o ON o.id=i.transfer_order_id LEFT JOIN wm_inventory v ON v.warehouse_id=o.source_warehouse_id AND v.location_id=i.source_location_id AND v.material_id=i.material_id WHERE i.transfer_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY i.id
